recommendations.regimenLabel: Vasopressor + inotrope, cautious diuresis; treat the cause
steps: ICU; treat the cause — urgent revascularisation for ischaemic cause.
Inotrope/vasopressor (e.g. noradrenaline ± dobutamine) titrated to perfusion.
Cautious diuresis/fluid guided by filling status; treat arrhythmia.
Consider mechanical support (IABP/Impella/ECMO) in selected cases.
Invasive monitoring; serial lactate, urine output.

drugRefs.why: Preferred first-line vasopressor in cardiogenic shock (lower arrhythmia/mortality vs dopamine); restores coronary and organ perfusion pressure.
Beta-1 inotrope augments contractility and cardiac output when hypoperfusion persists despite adequate perfusion pressure.
Relieves pulmonary/systemic congestion once perfusion is being supported; use cautiously and only when filling status allows.

refs: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22e — Cardiogenic Shock and Pulmonary Edema
2021 ESC Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Treatment of Acute and Chronic Heart Failure
2023 ESC Guidelines for the Management of Acute Coronary Syndromes

confirm: Hypotension with hypoperfusion despite adequate filling, due to pump failure (often after large MI). Raised lactate, low cardiac output, congestion.
